title: Crispy Potato Tornado 🌪️🥔 spiral street snack from scratch #shorts

segments.moment_description: Preparing the potatoes in the kitchen
Spiral-cutting the potato onto a skewer
Deep-frying the tornado potato golden and crisp
Seasoning the crispy spiral with spices
Sharing and eating the crispy potato tornado

description:
Crispy Potato Tornado 🌪️🥔 — one whole potato spiral-cut onto a skewer, fried till shatter-crisp and dusted with spicy masala. The viral street snack, made from scratch at home.

What seasoning would you dust on yours — peri-peri, cheese or chaat masala? 👇

🌿 Made with a whole potato, spiral-cut, coated and fried, then seasoned with chilli and chaat masala — crunchy in every bite.

Did you know? The spiral cut isn't just for looks — it massively increases the surface area, so every twist turns extra crispy and soaks up more masala.
